# crosswork_l2vpn_rd_sets (Data Source)

This data source can read an L2VPN route distinguisher set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_l2vpn_rd_sets" "example" {
  id   = "cwtest-l2-rds"
  name = "cwtest-l2-rds"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the RD set. Any ASCII character except `%`, `?` and `#`.

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `rd` (Set of String) Route distinguishers of the set, as `65000:1` or `1.1.1.1:1`
